title: Tool Connections
seo: Connect email, CRM and chat tools
meta: Your email, files, CRM and chat tools connected so information moves without copying. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Tool connections for email, files, CRM and chat
overview: If your team copies details from one app into another all day, we can connect them. We link tools such as Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, HubSpot, Airtable and your store so that a new item in one place creates or updates the right item in the next. Each connection is tested with real examples, set up in your own accounts with limited permissions, and listed in a short map so you always know what talks to what.

pkgs.blurb: Two of your tools connected with one working automation.
Up to four tools linked with several automations.
A connected set of tools with fallbacks and clear handover.

faq: Most popular business tools that offer an official connection, including Gmail, Outlook, Google Drive, Slack, Teams, HubSpot, Airtable, Notion and Shopify. Send us your list and we confirm before starting.
No. You authorize each tool from your own account, or add us as a user with limited access. You can remove that access at any time.
Who pays for the connection platform?
Tools such as Zapier or Make bill you directly, and some tasks run free on their starting plans. We tell you in advance what plan your setup is likely to need.
What if a tool changes and a connection breaks?
Alerts tell you when something fails. Fixes after the handover are not part of this fixed price, but we can quote ongoing care separately if you want it.
